name: International Travel House Ltd
about: Incorporated  in 1981, International Travel House Limited (ITH) started operations as India's first publicly listed travel company. At present, company is engaged in business of providing travel related services to travelers in India and abroad.[1]
keyPoints:
Overview[1]
International Travel House Ltd. commenced its operations in 1981 and went public in Sep 1993. The company is an International Air Transport Association (IATA) member and offers tickets of 265 member airlines by using the Billing and Settlement Plan (BSP) system of IATA.

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 39.5% CAGR over last 5 years
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 32.6 days to 13.0 days
